snippet.title: Tum Kya Mile - Lyrical | Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani | Ranveer,Alia,Arijit,Shreya,Pritam,Amitabh
snippet.description:
Sing along to the romantic anthem of the year with this lyrical version of "Tum Kya Mile" starring "Ranveer Singh" and "Alia Bhatt" and sung by "Arijit Singh" and "Shreya Ghoshal"

Don’t forget to like, share for more musical journeys through Bollywood’s golden era. 
👉 @https://www.youtube.com/@InstrumentalLoveSongs-j1l

Song Credits:
Singer: Arijit Singh & Shreya Ghoshal
Composer: Pritam
Lyrics: Amitabh Bhattacharya
Choreographer: Vaibhavi Merchant

Lyrical:

बेरंगे थे दिन, बेरंगी शामें 
आई है तुमसे रंगीनिया

फीके थे लम्हें जीने में सारे 
आई है तुमसे नमकीनिया

बे-इरादा रास्तों की 
बन गये हो मंज़िलें 
मुश्किलें हल हैं तुम्ही से
या तुम्ही हो मुश्किलें

तुम क्या मिले, तुम क्या मिले
हम ना रहे हम तुम क्या मिले 

जैसे मेरे दिल में खिले
फागुन के मौसम तुम क्या मिले

तुम क्या मिले, तुम क्या मिले 
तुम क्या मिले, तुम क्या मिले

कोरे काग़ज़ों की ही तरह है
इश्क़ बिना जवानीयाँ

दर्ज हुई है शायरी में 
जिनकी हैं प्रेम कहानियाँ
हम ज़माने की निगाहों में 
कभी गुमनाम थे
अपने चर्चे कर रही हैं।
अब शहर की महफिलें

तुम क्या मिले, तुम क्या मिले
हम ना रहे हम, तुम क्या मिले

जैसे मेरे दिल में खिले
फागुन के मौसम, तुम क्या मिले

तुम क्या मिले, तुम क्या मिले
तुम क्या मिले, तुम क्या मिले

In Episode 10, the artists step onto the stage carrying more than just bars. They bring the sounds, stories and influences of the places they call home.
Each artist has the chance to represent their roots and turn their culture into a performance that is uniquely their own.

Who will bring their roots to life and leave a lasting mark on the stage?

snippet.title: Franklin Finds 12 Magic Stones! 😱 Saves los santos from Shindo Dragon – GTA 5 Malayalam
snippet.description:
Franklin and Shinchan go to the market for a crazy car jumping challenge! 🚗💨 After winning the challenge, they bring home lots of amazing diecast cars. But then Shinchan finds a mysterious suitcase… 😱

Inside the suitcase, Franklin discovers two ancient magical stones! 🔮 Suddenly, dangerous Shadow Cones appear, and Franklin realizes that these stones have incredible powers! ⚡

Franklin and Shinchan then meet Dr. Jetka, who reveals a shocking secret about Jackie Chan's uncle and a mysterious building controlled by the American Boss. Franklin must use the power of the ancient stones to rescue him! 💥

But the biggest danger is still waiting… 🐉

Franklin discovers 12 powerful ancient stones, but one stone is missing — the Dragon Stone, which is with Shindo! 😱 Shindo uses the Dragon Stone and transforms into a GIANT DRAGON, attacking the entire city! 🔥🐉

Can Franklin use the remaining 11 stones to defeat Shindo and save the city? ❤️

Watch the full adventure to find out! 🎮🔥

ಶ್ರೀ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ಸಹಸ್ರನಾಮ ಸ್ತೋತ್ರಮ್ | Varalakshmi Vratham Special Songs | Lakshmi Sahasranamam Kannada

Listen to the divine Sri Lakshmi Sahasranama Stotram in Kannada with Lyrics, a powerful and sacred hymn dedicated to Goddess Mahalakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and abundance. Chanting or listening to the Lakshmi Sahasranama brings peace, financial growth, and divine blessings into your life.

This sacred stotram contains the 1000 names of Goddess Lakshmi, each representing her divine qualities and blessings. Devotees believe that reciting or listening to Lakshmi Sahasranama removes financial problems, fulfills wishes, and brings happiness, success, and prosperity.

This Kannada Lakshmi Sahasranama with lyrics is perfect for Friday prayers, daily devotion, Varalakshmi Vratham, and spiritual upliftment. Let the divine grace of Sri Mahalakshmi Devi fill your life with abundance and positivity.

🙏 Om Sri Mahalakshmiyai Namaha
🙏 Lakshmi Devi Blessings Always

देवोत्थानी शुक्लपक्ष की, दुखनाशक मैया।
पावन मास में करूं विनती पार करो नैया ।। ॐ ।।
परमा कृष्णपक्ष में होती, जन मंगल करनी।।

जो कोई आरती एकादशी की, भक्ति सहित गावै।

snippet.title: ವರಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿ ಆರತಿ | Vara Mahalakshmi Songs | Ashtalakshmi Devi Aarti | Soumya Manjunath
snippet.description:
ವರಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿ ಆರತಿ | Vara Mahalakshmi Songs | Ashtalakshmi Devi Aarti | Soumya Manjunath

Song : Varamahalaxmi Arati
Singer : Soumya Manjunath
Lyrics : Soumya Manjunath 
Compose : Soumya Manjunath
Music : Vijay krishna
Producer : Soumya Manjunath
DOP : Sangeetha Mane Team 
Publicity Designer : Darshan Kalburgi 
Music Distributer : Praveen Kadapatti 

Special Thanks to 
Madhushree M Pattar 
Manjunath Hosaval 
Pratibha M Hullur 
Malasa M Pattar 
Vijayapur, NGO colony's all womens who came in vedio



ವರಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ಪೂಜೆಯ ಈ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಂಗಲೆಯರೆಲ್ಲರೂ ಸೇರಿ ದೇವಿಯನ್ನು ಪೂಜಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಭಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಹಾಡಬಹುದಾದ ಸುಂದರ ಮಂಗಳಾರತಿ ಗೀತೆ ಇದಾಗಿದೆ.

ಈ ಹಾಡಿನ ವಿಶೇಷತೆ ಎಂದರೆ, ಇದು ಕೇವಲ ವರಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಯ ಮಂಗಳಾರತಿ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲದೆ, ಅಷ್ಟಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಯರಿಗೂ ಅರ್ಪಿಸಲಾದ ವಿಶೇಷ ಮಂಗಳಾರತಿ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಆದಿಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ, ಧನಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ, ಧಾನ್ಯಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ, ಗಜಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ, ಸಂತಾನಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ, ಧೈರ್ಯಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ, ವಿಜಯಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಯರ ಕೃಪೆ ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಮೇಲಿರಲಿ. 🙏✨

ಸುಮಂಗಲೆಯರೊಂದಿಗೆ ದೇವಿ ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ, ವರಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ವ್ರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಗೂ ವಿಶೇಷ ಪೂಜಾ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಭಕ್ತಿಗೀತೆಯನ್ನು ಹಾಡಿ ದೇವಿಯ ಕೃಪೆಗೆ ಪಾತ್ರರಾಗೋಣ. 🌺


This is a beautiful and sacred Mangalaarati song for Varalakshmi Pooja, sung with devotion while married women and devotees come together to worship Goddess Lakshmi.

The special highlight of this song is that it is not only a Mangalaarati for Goddess Varalakshmi, but also a special Aarti dedicated to the divine Ashtalakshmi forms – Adi Lakshmi, Dhana Lakshmi, Dhanya Lakshmi, Gaja Lakshmi, Santana Lakshmi, Dhairya Lakshmi, Vijaya Lakshmi and Vidya Lakshmi. ✨🙏

May the blessings of Goddess Ashtalakshmi bring happiness, prosperity, peace, wealth, courage, success and abundance into every home. 🌺


#Soumyamanjunath #Varamahalaxmisong #Asthtalaxmideviaarti #Varalakshmipooja #Devimangalarati #Ashtalakshmideviaarti 
#Varalakshmivrutaspecial 
#Varamahalakshmiarati
#varamahalakshmipoojavidhanainkannada #varamahalakshmisareedraping
#varamahalakshmisareedecoration #varamahalakshmipooja
#varamahalakshmisong
#varamahalakshmisongskannada #ವರಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಪೂಜೆಮಾಡುವವಿಧಾನ #
#ವರಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ಹಾಡುಗಳು

Ashtalakshmi Devi Aarti 
Varalakshmi Vrata Special 
Varamahalakshmi arati,
varamahalakshmi pooja vidhana in kannada varamahalakshmi saree draping
Soumya Manjunath Devi Songs 
Pujeya Madona Devige
Devi Mangalaruti
varamahalakshmi songs kannada 
ವರಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡುವ ವಿಧಾನ 
ವರಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ಪೂಜಾ 
ವರಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ಹಾಡುಗಳು


Lyrics :

ಆರತಿ ಬೇಳಗೋಣ ನಾವು ಆರತಿ ಬೇಳಗೋಣ
ಅಷ್ಟ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಯರಿಗೆ ಆರತಿ ಬೆಳಗೋಣ llPll

ಆದಿಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಗೆ ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ವರ ಬೇಡೋಣ
ಧಾನ್ಯಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಗೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಭಾಗ್ಯವ ಬೇಡೋಣ ll1ll

ಧೈರ್ಯ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಗೆ ನಾವು ಧೈರ್ಯವ ಬೇಡೋಣ
ಗಜಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಗೆ ನಾವು ಭಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ನಮಿಸೋಣ ll2ll

ಸಂತಾನಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಗೆ ಸುಖ ಕುಟುಂಬವನು ಕೇಳೋಣ
ವಿಜಯಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಗೆ ವಿಜಯವಾಗಲೆಂದು ಬೇಡೋಣ ll3ll

ವಿದ್ಯಾಲಕ್ಷೀ ದೇವಿಗೆ ವಿದ್ಯೆ ಬುದ್ಧಿಯ ಬೇಡೋಣ
ಧನಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀ ದೇವಿಗೆ ಕಷ್ಟ ಪರಿಹರಿಸೆಂದು ಕೇಳೋಣ ll4ll

-------------------------

https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQeljbfXMX_5a2_KMXTkF-A/join

♪ Song : Gamda Na Dilnu Shu Thashe - ગામડા ના દિલનું શું થાશે

♪ 𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐦 𝐑𝐞𝐞𝐥𝐬 : https://surl.li/jkexdi
♪ 𝐀𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐌𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐜 : https://surl.li/ohozib
-----------------------------
📝 𝐋𝐲𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐬: Gujarati 👇

હે તેતો મારગ જાલ્યો બજાર નો 
મારા ગામડાના દિલનું શું થાશે
હે મને અફશોષ થયો એક વાત નો
માયા તારી ચમ ની ભુલાશે   
દિવા જેવા દાડે અંધારુ લાગે  
તારું આલેલું ફૂલ પથ્થર થઇ ને વાગે 
હે તેતો છેડો હે એ એ છેડો ફાડ્યો હંગાથ નો 
રણી ધણી કુણ મારુ થશે
હે તેતો મારગ જાલ્યો બજાર નો 
મારા ગામડાના દિલનું શું થાશે

હો અમારા પ્રેમ માં ઓસુ શું પડ્યું 
કીધા કહ્યા વગર પગલું આવુ ભર્યું  
હો અમે તો સપનું જોયું તારા નોમનુ
જીવ જતો રયો પસી ખોળિયું શું કોમનુ
હે તેતો વિચારી લીધું ચમ એકજ તારુ     
જીવ થોડો ના બાળ્યો શું થાશે મારુ 
હે તેતો જબરો હે એ એ જબરો 
હે તેતો જબરો ખેલ્યો શે ખેલ રે
મારા ગામડાના દિલનું શું થાશે
હે તને હવા લાગી બજાર ની  
મારા ગામડાના દિલનું શું થાશે 

હો વાયરે વાતો આ વહેતી રે થાશે
દુશ્મનો જોઈ મને રોજ દોત કાઢશે 
હો તારા વગર નું હવે કેમ નું જીવાશે 
એક એક દડો મને વરહ જેવો લાગશે  
અરે ઓના કરતા તો મારી જાવુ હારુ 
ખોટું કેતાતા પડ્યા માણહ મારુ 
હે મને અધમુવો હેઅધમુવો 
મને અધમુવો કરી નાખ્યો પ્રેમ માં 
મારા ગામડાના દિલનું શું થાશે 
તેતો મારગ જાલ્યો બજાર નો 
મારા ગામડાના દિલનું શું થાશે
---------------------------

Chant the sacred Govinda Namalu in Telugu and experience the divine blessings of Lord Venkateswara Swamy (Balaji). These powerful chants glorify Lord Govinda, the protector and savior of devotees, and are widely recited with deep faith and devotion.
